headline: California Legislation to Cut Red Tape for Heat Pumps
subheading: California's SB 222 aims to make heat pump permits faster and cheaper, and to stop HOAs from blocking them. Here's what the bill does, why an earlier version failed, and where it stands now.
seoTitle: California SB 222: Cutting Red Tape for Heat Pump Permits
description: California's SB 222, now law, speeds up heat pump permits, caps permit fees and stops HOAs from banning heat pumps. What the Heat Pump Access Act does.
